education.detail: Intermediate, Board of Intermediate Education, Andhra Pradesh, 1978-80

declared_cases.note: Serious = at least one section carries a maximum sentence of 5+ years. Of 10 pending cases, two qualify: one includes IPC 354 (assault on a woman with intent to outrage modesty, max 5 years) and 384 (extortion); another includes IPC 452 (house-trespass after preparation for hurt/assault, max 7 years). The remaining 8 pending cases involve lesser charges (IPC 143/147/148/149/188/323/324/332/341/353/505(1), CrPC). One case resulted in conviction: IPC 188/269/270/271 (Epidemic Diseases Act/Disaster Management Act violations) with a Rs 500 fine under CrPC 252 — this convicted case does not meet the serious threshold.
